nozzles.service: anode Cl2 (+ O2 side) to leach oxidation

material: Cathode titanium Grade 2, 3 mm. Anode titanium mesh, 1.5 mm, mixed-metal-oxide coated (AQS-STD-002 section 9). Tank and racks CPVC (X-MAT-09); 316L frame withdrawn (AQS-STD-002 M3). Corrosion allowance 0 mm on the titanium; hydride check per AQS-STD-002 section 9. Pit rate is not measured. Cathode annealed, no cold forming after anneal; anode protected from reverse current (AQS-REV-H2-001). IA-EW-04 arrives at 77.5 °C (edge conditions; X-MAT-09). EW_1 tank and racks CPVC per M5; EW_2 to EW_9 see 55 °C and stay PVC-U. Cell-to-cell transfer by free-fall launder with air break; floating DC; protection current on trip (AQS-STD-002 section 11).

design.service: electrowinning cell, chloride liquor 77.5 C in / cell-to-cell launder out
design.bus_pack: 2 x 110 x 6.3 mm Cu C101 per pole (AQS-BUS-001 Rev C EW-1 row)
design.basis: AQS-DUTY-051 Rev C section 1 and the EW_1 row of its section 2; duty section 9 supersedes the 2.5 V / CE 1.0 figures (Rev B basis: CE 0.85, 2.12 V).

layout.frame: origin at the envelope corner; x along 2670, y along 720, z up
layout.electrodes: anodes at x 85 + 100k (26), cathodes at x 135 + 100k (25); sheets y 60..660, z 160..580; tabs 120 wide rise to z 691 (study contact arrangement, AQS-STD-002 section 9: Ti tab against the Cu bar above the liquor line)
layout.bus: pack pair over the tab line: + y 240..350, - y 370..480 (20 mm creepage gap, AQS-STD-002 section 11); bars x 135..2535 on FRP pads at beam stations x 110/860/1610/2360; rectifier lugs at the -X bar ends
layout.nozzle_spread: the schedule gives face and height only; the along-face x positions are this layout's study choice, recorded per tag in check.nozzles_drawn
layout.vent_support: the schedule vent is face top on an open tank: two CPVC posts on the inner walls carry a rim bridge at z 750..760; the DN15 stub hangs to its 650 datum
layout.drain: N7 at the discharge-end sump (x 2500), flush at z 0, boss top at the 50 datum
layout.solids_ports: N10/N11 drawn at DN15 and labeled bore not calculated (AQS-PLAN-006 W4); hand/bin transfer interface
layout.hardware_idiom: connection hardware flush at the envelope faces (lib/nozzles.place_on_face default); nothing protrudes, bbox = size_mm
